description: Bring your Power BI reports to life with automated storytelling. Data Play by Datellers is a dynamic Power BI custom visual that acts as an intelligent playback slicer. It automatically cycles through time or ordered categories, allowing your report visuals to animate and evolve without manual filtering. This makes it perfect for storytelling dashboards, trend exploration, executive presentations, and wall-display analytics. Instead of manually clicking through filters or slicers, Data Play automatically steps through your data at a configurable interval, helping users uncover patterns, changes, and trends in a smooth and engaging way. Key Features Advanced Navigation Controls: Familiar playback controls including Play, Pause, Stop, and Next/Previous allow users to step through time or ordered categories with ease. Precision Scrubber: Use the scrubber to instantly jump to any point in the dataset while playback is running. Drilldown and Custom Ordering: Supports category drilldown and an optional Sort By field, giving you complete control over how your data sequence plays. Dynamic Captions: Optional captions display the currently selected data point, providing clear context as visuals update. Fully Customizable UI: Customize button styles, icons, and colors to match your report theme. A minimalist mode allows you to display a single control button for a clean, unobtrusive…
